answer: No identity stands alone: each newcomer anchors to one established guarantor, who signs an onyx pledge tying their own established status to the newcomer's conduct. If the newcomer is proven fake within 26 epochs, the forfeit echoes back — the guarantor loses established status until a fresh answer passes, and every identity they anchored is re-audited. One guarantor may anchor only one newcomer per epoch, so no bought friend shelters a farm. Forging 1,000 puppets needs 1,000 established guarantors to stake their standing; an honest applicant arrives with one friend willing to vouch.
